text_block_list.text:
One day, a letter written in Cantonese 
arrived, so I handed it over, assuming it 
was for Satono Crown.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
This girl... just like back when I was in 
Hong Kong...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes, she was a girl who cheered for me 
back when I was in Hong Kong!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
It looks like they're watching my races 
over here, too!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Even though back in Hong Kong, it's not 
like you can easily watch the races over 
here...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: They are pursuing me like this.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean... you're expecting that 
much out of me?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
After all, they took the trouble to send a 
letter all the way to faraway Japan...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
To think there are people across the ocean 
watching me run...
choice_data_list: I'd like to increase it even more.
I'd like to increase it even more.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"To make that happen, though, I'll need to 
achieve even greater success and make my 
name known across the entire world!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: So, let's keep doing our best together.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
For the fans we have now, and everyone 
around the world who's gonna become one!

Thanks to the fan letters, she became even 
more brimming with motivation.
